decisive_items: estimated pulmonary arterial pressure of 60 mmHg
response.rationale: Pulmonary embolism best explains the combination of right ventricular dilatation, elevated pulmonary arterial pressure, transient precordial ST elevation, and new right bundle branch block with normal coronary angiography. Takotsubo is less likely without a stressor and does not explain the right heart strain. Acute coronary syndrome is excluded by normal coronary arteries.

rejected.why: Takotsubo can cause ST elevation and normal coronaries but does not explain right ventricular dilatation and pulmonary hypertension, and no stressor is described.
Acute coronary syndrome is excluded by normal coronary angiography; the new RBBB and right heart strain point to pulmonary embolism.
